judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale:
Reference 1 in the 'Referências' list (p:nth-of-type(9)): the quoted span "Mapping the expressions and impacts of racism on health in Brazil: a scoping review. The Lancet" is English text with no lang, inherited as pt-BR. The page is lang="pt-BR" and neither the p nor its ancestors carry a lang attribute; the live HTML fetched on 2026-11-21 has the same markup (

with number and journal name, no lang), and the screenshot shows the same reference list, so the capture does not differ. Skeptic check: the journal name in and the DOI/year are exempt (proper name, indeterminate), but the article title is descriptive English prose, not a proper name in Understanding 3.1.2's sense (a name that distinctly identifies a person, place or brand) nor Portuguese vernacular, so no exception covers it and a pt-BR voice would mispronounce it. The claim names exactly this failure.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: "Informes" is a top-level menu toggle (<a href="#" data-bs-toggle="dropdown" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">) in the main navigation; it does not navigate, it opens the Informes submenu. Its purpose (open the 'Informes' section menu) is given by its text together with its parent list item, which is programmatically determined context and holds the submenu links (Comunicados, Posicionamentos e Notas Oficiais, Notícias Gerais, Noticias Científicas, Podcasts SBEM, Videocasts SBEM, SBEM na Mídia), and aria-haspopup announces it as a menu trigger. So the claim that nothing around it tells its purpose is false of the capture, and the link meets 2.4.4 (using a link with href="#" for a toggle is at most a 4.1.2 role question, not 2.4.4). Live HTML is identical, screenshot shows it as a nav item. The packet gave the checker the list item's text, so this is a model error.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Footer SBEM logo (sbem-logotipo-white.webp, alt=""); the crop shows the SBEM mark with the words 'Sociedade Brasileira de Endocrinologia e Metabologia'. The same footer (contentinfo) states that name as text in its copyright line, '2025 Sociedade Brasileira de Endocrinologia e Metabologia - SBEM CNPJ: ...' (#footer > div:nth-of-type(2) > p, visible in the screenshot), and the header logo already carries alt 'Logo SBEM' (page title also ends '- SBEM'). The image's only information is therefore available as text in the same landmark, so a null alt on this repeated logo loses nothing and is acceptable under 1.1.1; the claim that the text around it does not say this is false of the capture. Live HTML matches the snapshot. The copyright line sits outside the ancestor container the checker was given, hence context_missing.
